title: Momentum Turns
briefing: Kestrel Air has been flying higher for weeks. Watch the MACD histogram: it often shrinks before the price itself turns.
objective: Read MACD momentum: building, fading and crossing below its signal line.
debrief: Kestrel Air rallied for the first two weeks while the MACD histogram grew. From about day 15 the price stalled and the histogram shrank toward zero; MACD then crossed below its signal line before the fuel-price jump on day 22 pushed the stock into a slide. A disciplined player held the rally and sold when momentum turned, instead of waiting for the bad news.
